title: nephroia ferrandiana
intro: Nephroia ferrandiana, commonly known as Ferrand's kidneywort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Saxifragaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating kidney issues and other health conditions. The health benefits of Nephroia ferrandiana include its ability to act as a diuretic, promoting the removal of excess fluids from the body, as well as its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, tannins, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as anti-edematous, anti-hemorrhagic, and hepatoprotective effects.
